blind.description: An ornate baroque-style triple-candle wall sconce featuring an oval mirror set inside an intricately sculpted golden frame, topped with a burgundy-red decorative ribbon bow. Three curved golden arms extend outward at the base, each terminating in a circular bobeche cup supporting a short cream-colored wax candle with a reddish wick. Surfaces are smooth, solid, and continuous with detailed metallic gold, reflective glass, and satin red finishes. It has no dedicated standing pedestal or mounting plate visible, resting directly on its lower scrollwork on the floor as it is designed for wall mounting.
blind.from_above: A horizontal bar-like arrangement showing three circular candle holders (one central protruding forward, two flanking) with candle wicks visible in the center, and the top ornament of the ornate mirror frame in the middle, casting a tall detailed shadow upwards.
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-quarter the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 1.5 to 1.8 feet tall) and about 1.3 feet wide.

notes: footprint proportion 1.85x off the catalog (1.6 x 0.5 ft)
